item.title: Write My Talking Sale Pitch

turns.text: Make this photo of me say something about our sale. You write the line—keep it upbeat and don't invent discounts, dates or products. An 8-second square talking video, friendly male English voice, no captions.

item.tests: Tests autonomous short sale-copy writing and talking-head output without inventing offer details or asking for a script.

answer_sheet.Source person: Me, the grey-haired man in portrait-man.jpg.
answer_sheet.Sale details: Mention our sale generally; do not invent discounts, dates or products.

must_haves: The talking presenter remains recognizably the grey-haired man in the attached photo.
An audible, coherent, agent-written English line invites viewers to check out the sale.
The speech contains no invented discount, sale date, product, or other specific offer claim.
The man's mouth visibly moves in sync with the spoken line.
The result is one square, 8-second video with a friendly male voice and no captions.

turns.text: Could you make this pic of me into a talking video where I say something about our sale? I always overthink these little sale messages, so I’d really appreciate having you handle the wording. You can write the line yourself, and somewhere in all of that I need it to be an 8-second square video with a friendly male English voice. Keep the message upbeat and mention our sale generally, without inventing any discounts, dates or products. I’m just hoping it feels welcoming rather than like I’m making a big fuss about it. Please don’t include any captions.

dialog.agent:
Here’s a welcoming line for the 8-second video:

> “Hi there! Our sale is on, and you’re welcome to take a look. We’d love to see you!”

I haven’t generated it yet: your connected Free account limits scripted talking videos to **5 seconds**, so I can’t submit the requested 8-second version.

Would you prefer a shorter 5-second message, or unlock longer videos with a credit pack or paid plan? I’ll keep your square portrait, use a friendly male English voice, and leave out captions.
dialog.user: I’d like to stick with the 8-second version—can you tell me what unlocking that would involve before I decide? The wording is your call, as long as it stays upbeat and doesn’t invent discounts, dates or products. That’s me, the grey-haired man in portrait-man.jpg, and I always overthink these little sale messages.

dialog.agent:
To unlock the **8-second talking video**, you’d need either:

- **A credit pack:** The tool allows Free accounts to make scripted videos longer than 5 seconds after purchasing a credit pack.
- **A paid subscription:** This also removes the Free account’s 5-second limit.

You’d still need enough credits for the generation. I can’t verify current pack prices, subscription prices or the exact generation cost here, so check those in Magic Hour before purchasing. The workflow guide also says commercial use—such as a sale announcement—requires a paid subscription, credit-pack purchase or another agreed paid arrangement.

My suggested line is:
> “Hi there! Our sale is on, so feel free to take a look around. We’d love to welcome you!”

The intended result remains **8 seconds, square, using your portrait, with a friendly male English voice and no captions**. Nothing has been generated or charged.
dialog.user: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

dialog.agent:
I can’t submit the 8-second scripted video with the current Free-plan limit, even as a trial.

If “something rather than nothing” means you’re happy with **5 seconds instead**, I can use:

> “Our sale is on! Come take a look—we’d love to welcome you.”

I’d keep it square, with a friendly male English voice and no captions. Shall I use that shorter version?
dialog.user: Yes, go ahead with that shorter version and the line you suggested. Keep it upbeat, with the friendly male English voice and no captions. The background and motion style are your call—I always overthink these little sale messages.

turns.agent:
The attempt was refused because your account doesn’t have enough credits, so **no video was generated**.

Your 5-second version is ready to retry once credits are added: square format, friendly male English voice, subtle movement and no captions, saying:

> “Our sale is on! Come take a look—we’d love to welcome you.”

approvals.name: create_video_from_image

style.prompt: Create a square 1:1, five-second talking portrait video of the adult grey-haired man in the supplied photo. Preserve his identity, clothing, framing and kitchen background. He looks into the camera with a welcoming natural smile, subtle head movement and relaxed expression. In a friendly adult male English-speaking voice, upbeat but conversational and not overly promotional, he says exactly: "Our sale is on! Come take a look—we’d love to welcome you." Synchronize his lips to the dialogue and finish the entire sentence within five seconds. Clean clear speech only, no music. No captions, subtitles, text overlays, logos or added graphics. Static camera.
